strings.module.probing.name: Probing
strings.module.probing.description: Tool-length, edge, center, rotation and height-map probing cycles.
strings.module.probing.warning: Warning! Use with care - incorrect parameters may damage your probe!
strings.module.probing.toolLengthDesc: Probe Z downward onto the touch plate / fixture to establish the tool length offset.
strings.module.probing.storeProbed: store probed length into the tool table (grblHAL)
strings.module.probing.fixtureProbing: Fixture probing rapids to the fixture origin (0,0) and probes from there;
strings.module.probing.lockHint: Locked: X and Y sizes stay equal. Unlock to probe in one direction only.
strings.module.probing.passesHint: More than one pass is usually needed for accurate dimensions
strings.module.probing.rotationDesc: Probe two points along an edge to measure the angle of the workpiece.
strings.module.probing.applyRotationHint: Rotates the loaded program's X/Y coordinates by the probed angle
strings.module.probing.determineX0Y0: Determine X0, Y0 for right-angled workpiece
strings.module.probing.determineX0Y0Hint: Adds a probe point on the left edge and sets X0,Y0 at the probed corner
strings.module.probing.heightmapDesc: Probe a Z grid over the area. The map is stored relative to the first probed point.
strings.module.probing.addPauseHint: Wait for cycle start between probe points
strings.module.probing.instr.toolLength: Probe the touch plate/fixture to set the tool length offset.
strings.module.probing.instr.edge:
Click an edge, corner or Z in the diagram to select the probing action.
Move the probe above the indicated position before Start.
strings.module.probing.instr.center:
Place the probe above the approximate center of the workpiece before Start.
Select the axis and inside/outside probing first.
strings.module.probing.instr.rotation: Select an edge to probe two points along, then Start to measure the angle.
strings.module.probing.instr.heightmap: Set the map area and grid size, then Start to probe the grid.
strings.module.probing.notConnected: Not connected - connect first (or use Demo mode).
strings.module.probing.noPosition: Probing failed - no probe position captured
strings.module.probing.toolLengthStored: Tool length offset stored to T{0}: {1}
strings.module.probing.selectEdgeFirst: Select an edge or corner first
strings.module.probing.selectCenterFirst: Select a center probing mode first
strings.module.probing.notEnoughPos: Probing failed - not enough probe positions
strings.module.probing.xDistance: Probing completed: X distance {0}, Y distance {1}
strings.module.probing.selectRotationEdge: Select an edge for rotation probing
strings.module.probing.twoPosRequired: Probing failed - two probe positions required
strings.module.probing.threePosRequired: Probing failed - three probe positions required
strings.module.probing.cornerZeroed: X0,Y0 set at the probed corner: {0}
strings.module.probing.probeOrLoadFirst: Probe or load a height map first
strings.module.probing.xDistanceArrow: Probing completed: X distance {0}, Y distance {1} -> {2}
strings.module.probing.rapidsFeedRateHint: Feed for rapid moves; 0 uses the controller setting
strings.module.probing.searchFeedRateHint: Feed rate for the initial probing move
strings.module.probing.latchFeedRateHint: Feed rate for the second slow probing move
strings.module.probing.probingDistanceHint: Maximum distance of a probing move
strings.module.probing.latchDistanceHint: Retract before the slow probe; 0 skips it
strings.module.probing.xyClearanceHint: Initial distance away from the face to probe
strings.module.probing.offsetHint: Distance from the corner to the probe point
strings.module.probing.depthHint: Z below the start position where XY probing happens
strings.module.probing.xOffsetHint: X offset from the probe to the controlled point
strings.module.probing.yOffsetHint: Y offset from the probe to the controlled point
